definitions.full: H5627. sarah סָרָה noun feminine a turning aside, defection, apostasy, withdrawal ; — always absolute ׳ס ; — 1 defection , used apparently of any moral or legal offence Deut 19:16 , so probably Isa 59:13 (+ שָׁ֑קֶר דִּבְרֵי עשֶׁק, ). 2 apostasy , Deut 13:6 ; Isa 1:5 ; 31:6 ; Jer 28:16 ; 29:32 . 3 בִּלְתִּי סָרָה non-withdrawal Isa 14:6 (compare verb, 14:25 ; Amos 6:7 ). סִרָה see הַסּ ׳בּוֺר above יסור , only in יסורי Jer 17:13 Kt, but see Qr סור Qal Participle
